proposals.before: Governor Malaqi and Governor-General Ma Hu wrote: "Tianyan is honest, capable, and energetic. He is clearing long-standing tax arrears and untangling misallocated payments, but the task is unfinished. We ask that he be permitted to observe mourning without leaving his post."
proposals.after: Governor-General Malaqi and Governor Ma Hu wrote: "Tianyan is honest, capable, and energetic. He is clearing long-standing tax arrears and untangling misallocated payments, but the task is unfinished. We ask that he be permitted to observe mourning without leaving his post."
proposals.reason: Chinese 總督麻勒吉、巡撫瑪祜 assigns governor-general to Malaqi and provincial governor to Ma Hu; the idiomatic English reverses these offices.

proposals.before: Jiangnan's waterways form a dense network. As provincial treasurer, Tianyan asked Governor-General Ma Hu to dredge the silted Wusong and Liu rivers.
proposals.after: Jiangnan's waterways form a dense network. As provincial treasurer, Tianyan asked Governor Ma Hu to dredge the silted Wusong and Liu rivers.
proposals.reason: Chinese 巡撫瑪祜 is provincial governor, not governor-general; same office error as in s0010.

proposals.before: Jiangnan's waterways crisscross one another. While Tianyan was provincial treasurer, he asked Governor-General Ma Hu to dredge the silted channels of the Wusong River and the Liu River.
proposals.after: Jiangnan's waterways crisscross one another. While Tianyan was provincial treasurer, he asked Governor Ma Hu to dredge the silted channels of the Wusong River and the Liu River.
proposals.reason: Literal English also mistranslates 巡撫 as Governor-General.

proposals.before: Ga Li is not fit to speak of this; Tianyan and A Shan cannot be compared either.
proposals.after: Ga Li is not fit to speak of this; indeed Tianyan and A Shan also could not understand it.
proposals.reason: Chinese 弗能喻 means could not understand/grasp this point, not 'cannot be compared'.

proposals.after: Ga Li is not fit to speak of this; indeed Tianyan and A Shan also could not understand it.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise mistranslates 喻 as 'compared' rather than 'understand'.

decisions.reason: s0010 has 總督麻勒吉、巡撫瑪祜: 總督 belongs to Malaqi and 巡撫 to Ma Hu. The original English reverses the offices; the proposed Governor-General / Governor pairing matches the Chinese.
s0027 has 請於巡撫瑪祜; 巡撫 is provincial governor, not governor-general. Changing Governor-General Ma Hu to Governor Ma Hu corrects the office title.
The literal likewise renders 巡撫瑪祜 as Governor-General; Governor Ma Hu is the accurate title for 巡撫.
s0194 ends 蓋天顏、阿山亦弗能喻也; 喻 means understand/grasp, not compare. The proposed 'could not understand it' restores the sense of 弗能喻.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 蓋天顏、阿山亦弗能喻也

decisions.reason: The literal repeats the same misreading of 喻 as 'compared'; 'could not understand it' correctly translates 弗能喻.
